integrity: The unrefined 2^n+n+1 closure count and individual diamond normal forms are prior results; the assessed claim is the maximal commutation classification and arbitrary-arity enumeration, with a mathematical proof and independent bounded computations.
limitations: n≥3, labelled atoms, extensive isotone idempotent maps, no join/meet preservation; general finite lattices are not classified; priority assessment is best-of-knowledge.
title: Maximal commuting families of closure modalities on finite diamond lattices
